deviations_from_plan: The plan's 'untouched' tests snapshot the seeded locator as `{ ...worker.claim().locator }`; that spreads an optional and tsc rejects it against `toEqual(WorkerLocator | undefined)`. Replaced with `structuredClone(worker.claim().locator)` in the five tests — same assertion (deep-equal against a snapshot, so an in-place mutation or a cleared locator both fail), correct type.

Biome reformatted three files after the commits (config.ts's if-condition onto one line; wrapping in config.test.ts and processes.test.ts); squashed into the owning step's commit per Step 6 (`jj squash --into`).

No other deviation. The connectAttempts() === 2 assertion in Step 2 test 1 held as the plan reasoned: onWorkerClientClosed runs before stopProcess evicts the client from the cache (it was registered first on client.closed), finds the locator still set and confirmed, spends its one reconnect probe (refused), and its markWorkerDead queues behind retireIdleWorker's critical section, where markWorkerDeadLocked's pane-id re-check returns early.
